title: Direct-seq: employing programmed gRNA scaffold for streamlined scRNA-seq in CRISPR screen
protocol: At the end of CRISPR screening, cells were prepared as single cell suspension and loaded into the Chromium Single Cell B Chip.
cDNA was generated, purified, and amplified following the manual of Chromium Single-Cell 3′ Reagent Kits v3 User Guide.
Long cDNA fragments were size-selected by 0.6x AMPure XP beads.
The "long cDNA" was eluted in nuclease-free H2O following the 10x protocol.
Short cDNA fragments, mostly representing index gRNA, were collected from the supernatant of the 0.6x beads selection.
A 1.2x size selection followed for short cDNA collection.
The "short cDNA" was eluted in 25 μl nuclease-free H2O.
The "long cDNA" was used for mRNA library preparation by following the manual of Chromium Single-Cell 3′ Reagent Kits v3 User Guide.

Conduct eight index gRNA enrichment PCR reactions with 3 μl template, 25 μL NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix (NEB #M0544S), 2.5 μL tRNA_Read2 primer (10uM), 2.5 μL P5_read1 primer (10uM) and nuclease-free water up to 50 μL.
Set PCR program as: 98 °C for 30 s, followed by 14 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s, 60 °C for 10 s, then 72 °C for 10 s and finally 72 °C for 2 min.

Combine PCR products and purify by 0.7–1.0× double-sided size selection, collecting supernatant from the 0.7x beads size selection followed by 1.0x beads selection, then eluting in 80 μl of nuclease-free water.
Conduct five library preparation PCR reactions with 10 μL template, 25 uL NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 2.5 uL P7_Read2_Index2 primer (10μM) and 2.5 uL P5_read1 primer (10uM).
Set PCR program as: 98 °C for 30 s, followed by 5 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s, then 54 °C for 15 s, then 65°C for 20 s and finally 72 °C for 2 min.
Size select the cleaned PCR product with 0.7–1.0x AMPure XP beads.
Send an aliquot of the quantified DNA for NGS sequencing using the Illumina platform.
